visualCharacteristics.purpose: Golden-ticket "how to enter" panel: star-bracketed title, a row of illustrated steps and entry CTAs on a light card.

contentPattern.structure: Rows with a picture = a step (picture, heading = step title, other text below); a row of CTA paragraphs = links; any other row = panel title.

reuseGuidance: Reuse promo-steps wherever the same content pattern appears; authored content is moved into the block's layout, so keep the structure above.
